{{Quote|Here's the location to a Smuggler by the name of Dak. I'm afraid he's way out by Mt. Chaolt...|[[Ralia Reeven]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GtP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Gimme the Prize|Lok}}</ref>}}
'''Dak Vox''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There's a great need for liquid filtration supplies throughout the galaxy and the Empire has been trying to corner the market. Fortunately, this volcano produces excellent deposits of one type of coagulant.|Dak Vox, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:IWIA" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Dak Vox had set up camp on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] [[Mount Chaolt]], on the planet Lok. There, the smuggler collected chemicals generated by the volcano in order to produce valuable cationic chemical coagulant that could be sold on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="SWG:IWIA" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and his [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] traveled from the city known as [[Nym's Stronghold]] to Mount Chaolt in order to obtain cationic chemical coagulant from Dak Vox. The chemicals were requested by the [[Water/Legends|water]] treatment [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Phor Cl-lan]] in order to repair the water treatment facility of the city. The spacer was sent to the volcano by [[Ralia Reeven]], Nym's [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]], who was aware of Vox's business. As he owed Nym a favor, the smuggler could not refuse to provide chemicals. However, he asked the spacer to help him collect raw chemicals in exchange for the cationic chemical coagulant. The adventurer accepted the trade and then gathered chemicals on the slopes of the volcano.<ref name="SWG:IWIA" /> The spacer eventually returned to Nym's Stronghold with the cationic chemical coagulant that was used to resupply the mixing chamber of the water filtration system.<ref name="SWG:RtMC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Resupply the Mixing Chamber|Lok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dak Vox was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IWIA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dak Vox was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:IWIA" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
